name: IGM Financial
description: IGM Financial is a Toronto Stock Exchange-listed Canadian wealth and asset manager that runs IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments for Canadian investors, with about C$310 billion in assets.

name: Intuit
description: Intuit makes financial software including TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma and Mailchimp for consumers, small businesses and accountants, serving about 100 million customers and listed on Nasdaq.

name: Upstart
description: Upstart runs an AI lending marketplace that matches consumers seeking personal, auto and home equity loans with more than 100 partner banks and credit unions, and is listed on Nasdaq.

name: HiBob
description: HiBob makes Bob, a cloud HR platform covering core HR, payroll, performance and compensation for mid-sized companies, used by more than 4,000 businesses worldwide.

name: Flatiron Energy
description: Flatiron Energy develops, owns and operates utility-scale standalone battery storage projects that help US grids integrate renewables, with a portfolio of about 4.5 GW including Massachusetts sites.

name: Optasia
description: Optasia uses AI to provide airtime credit and microloans through mobile operators and banks to underserved consumers in about 38 countries, and is listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

name: BrightSpeed
description: Brightspeed is a US telecom provider offering fiber and DSL internet, Wi-Fi and voice services to homes and small businesses across a 20-state footprint, with over 3 million fiber-enabled locations.

name: Westpac
description: Westpac is one of Australia's four major banks, providing consumer, business and institutional banking in Australia and New Zealand to about 13 million customers, and is listed on the ASX.

name: Jersey Mike's Subs
description: Jersey Mike's Subs is a franchised sub sandwich chain selling to consumers through about 3,000 shops open or in development across the United States, with some locations in Canada.
note: Majority stake acquired by Blackstone (deal agreed Nov 2024, about $8B valuation)

name: Figma
description: Figma makes browser-based collaborative design and prototyping software used by designers, developers and product teams, with over 13 million monthly users, and has been listed on the NYSE since 2025.

name: OPC Energy
description: OPC Energy is a Tel Aviv-listed independent power producer that builds and runs gas, solar and wind plants in Israel and, through its CPV unit, the United States.

name: EnergyRe
description: energyRe develops utility-scale wind, solar, storage and high-voltage transmission projects for US power markets, with a pipeline across 17 states and a $1.2 billion capital raise in 2023.

name: Hyperliquid Strategies
description: Hyperliquid Strategies is a Nasdaq-listed company that holds HYPE, the token of the Hyperliquid blockchain, as a treasury asset for public investors, launching with about 12.6 million HYPE.
note: Formed by merger with Sonnet BioTherapeutics (closed Dec 2025); trades as PURR

name: DailyPay
description: DailyPay provides earned wage access software that employers offer so workers can withdraw pay they have already earned before payday, working with more than 1,000 US employers.

name: Recursion Pharmaceuticals
description: Recursion is a clinical-stage biotech that uses AI and its Recursion OS platform to discover drugs, partnering with drugmakers such as Roche, Sanofi and Bayer, and is listed on Nasdaq.

name: BluPine Energy
description: BluPine Energy is an Actis-owned independent power producer that develops and operates renewable energy projects in India, including for commercial and industrial buyers, with about 3.9 GW across 10 states.
note: Owner Actis running a sale process (2025); no buyer confirmed

name: KoBold Metal
description: KoBold Metals uses AI to find and develop copper, lithium, cobalt and nickel deposits, led by its Mingomba copper project in Zambia, and is valued near $3 billion.
